column1: Unable to Disable Phase Display in Scheduler
column30:
Issue:
John Deere reports that when they go into the Hackathon Scheduler, click on an individual Phase, and try to disable the option to show that Phase in widgets and save, the Phase does not get disabled. If you click into it again, the check box is rechecked

Steps to Reproduce
1. Navigate to https://innovate.deere.com/FOCUSInnovationDay
2. Go to Site Setup > Scheduling
3. Click on any Phase in the Scheduler to edit
4. Uncheck the box for "Display Phase in Widgets and Countdown"
5. Select Save Schedule
6. Click back into the same Phase after the modal closes
7. Notice that the box is rechecked

Additional Notes:
Support can replicate internally and in client's site.
